### Devotional: Psalms 135–136
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/joshua-6-psalms-135-136-isaiah-66-matthew-14/
Passage: Psalm 135:1-21
Points:
- The psalm forms an exuberant tapestry of praise woven largely from allusions to earlier biblical passages.
- It summons God's servants to worship Him for His goodness, electing love, and absolute sovereignty over creation.
- Remembering God's historical redemptive acts highlights the futility and spiritual deadness of human-made idols.
- Deep familiarity with Scripture enriches private and corporate devotion, keeping prayer from devolving into shallow clichés.
